goal: Ensure subtree merge commits can be reused verbatim when backporting to maintenance branches
Save reviewer effort by avoiding re-reviewing newly generated subtree merges for each release branch
agreement: Disputed over whether automating backportability checks justifies the maintenance overhead
Approach NACK: bash logic adds maintenance overhead for a style preference verifiable via git log (maflcko)
Supports enforcing backportability to save reviewer effort across release branches (ryanofsky)
Verified by testing that the backportability check passes and errors as expected (BrandonOdiwuor)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it adds repository linting to catch subtree commits that cannot be cleanly backported
Benefits maintainers and reviewers by avoiding repeated verification of subtree merges across releases
